mechanism.claim: An own-history five-minute spot quote-turnover shock that is not accompanied by an upper-quartile perpetual turnover state identifies cash-led information sponsorship rather than leverage-driven churn. When completed spot and perpetual returns agree during elevated BTC variation, follow their common direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed spot and perpetual five-minute returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSPSR uses daily spot share of combined turnover; HVCPMR compares first-versus-second-half participation migration; spot-flow leadership uses taker imbalance. HVCVCSS uses an irregular absolute spot turnover shock together with a non-shocked perpetual counterfactual and no flow sign, ticket size, basis, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual twenty-four-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular cash-only participation shocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.bar: five exact coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT rows [D-5m,D) independently for Binance spot and perpetual
features.venue_return: log(last completed close/first completed open), both finite strict nonzero and same sign
features.venue_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume, independently finite strict positive
features.history: 8640 strictly prior source-valid venue observations (30 days), current excluded; minimum 6048
features.cash_only_shock: spot turnover>=spot q95 and perpetual turnover<perpetual q75
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_history: at most 8640 strictly prior source-valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded
features.onset: full cash-only direction state true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed venue bars are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, bar, turnover, history, quantile, quiet counterfactual, agreement, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
